name: powerbi-desktop
description: AI-assisted local Power BI Desktop and Fabric engineering workbench with 12-USP Max AI review, fix-until-green loops, Copilot evaluation, data contracts, Fabric deployment risk simulation, visual intent analysis, broken-measure root-cause graphs, KPI trust twins, review memory, natural-language PBIP authoring, governance rule mining, explainable DAX refactoring, report decision simulation, autonomous PBIP fix loops, live-vs-repo reconciliation, semantic measure expectations, PR release comments, KPI trust contracts, local Ask My Model, Fabric readiness planning, unified offline/live review, External Tools install/uninstall, golden baseline tests, PBIP Apply Engine, native BPA, model compare, and live DMV analysis.

interface.shortDescription: AI workbench for local Power BI Desktop projects.
interface.longDescription: Adds an AI-assisted Power BI Desktop workbench for local projects and open Desktop sessions: PBIP Apply Engine for measures, calculated columns, Power Query, generic TMDL, and report pages; native BPA rules, native model compare, native model documentation, DAX performance and VertiPaq-style heuristics, live DMV analysis, report render-readiness checks, calculation group drafts, relationship drafts, RLS role drafts, Power Query/M drafts, service integration planning, incremental refresh drafts, aggregation drafts, schema-aware visual planning, report layout checks, theme audit, PBIP source-control planning, PBIP report page and visual authoring drafts, PBIP-to-PBIX compile workflows, optional external-tool awareness, live XMLA/ADOMD model discovery, PBIX/PBIT/PBIP inventory, PBIP structure analysis, configurable governance rules, dependency graphs, AI prompt packs, business semantic layers, KPI trust scoring, decision-risk analysis, release gates, guided fixes, semantic diffs, measure lineage impact, generated DAX test plans, report narrative and UX critique, executive explainability, governance scorecards, Copilot readiness and optimization, release checklists, semantic metric catalogs, report UX blueprints, and safe PBIP/TMDL refactoring guidance.
